title: Indifferentiability of Key-Reuse AEAD Compositions
summary: The three modified key-reuse AEAD compositions are plausible indifferentiability candidates, but proving or disproving their indifferentiability remains open.

formal_statement.body: Determine whether the three modified generic AEAD compositions with key reuse---respectively, enhanced Encrypt-and-MAC, Encrypt-then-MAC, and MAC-then-Encrypt---are indifferentiable. In each candidate, $N$ and $A$ are included in the computation of the initialization vector, and $(N,A,M)$ is included in the computation of the tag $T$. These constructions are plausible indifferentiability candidates, but proving or disproving their indifferentiability remains open.

scope.domain: Symmetric cryptography concerning generic authenticated-encryption compositions and indifferentiability.
parameters: Candidate transforms: enhanced Encrypt-and-MAC, Encrypt-then-MAC, and MAC-then-Encrypt
Key reuse: the setting for the three modified generic AEAD compositions
N and A: inputs included in the initialization-vector computation
N, A, and M: inputs included in the tag computation producing T
scope.unresolved_remainder: Whether these three candidate transforms are indifferentiable, by either proving or disproving indifferentiability, remains unresolved.

progress.summary: The source presents the three modified key-reuse transforms as plausible indifferentiability candidates. It explicitly leaves proving or disproving their indifferentiability to future work.
citation_labels: Manuel Barbosa et al., Indifferentiable Authenticated Encryption
